title: arctium lappaceum
intro: Arctium lappaceum, commonly known as the Greater Burdock, is a biennial thistle-like plant native to Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as eczema, acne, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Arctium lappaceum include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include arctiin, lactones, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory properties.
